ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution with a ratio of approximately 40:60 (white:black); high-intensity pixels are localized to the distal-lateral regions while low-intensity pixels dominate the central and basal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Distal-lateral white patches on both lobes. Right lobe contains a prominent black circular focal spot within the white field. Left lobe contains a vertical black linear streak bisecting the white field. The central peduncle connection is solid low-intensity black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped depression with an internal angle of approximately 70 degrees and a depth-to-width ratio of approximately 1:6.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations on the left lobe including two distinct jagged indentations. Right lobe displays lower-amplitude, more uniform peak-and-valley topography along the trailing boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave-to-convex transition; the curve follows an outward sweep from the notch before curving sharply at the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity white circular pixel groups consistent with sessile organism attachments located at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single distinct vertical low-intensity linear disruption visible on the white field of the left lobe; multiple faint horizontal pixel-intensity shifts on the lower right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Two deep, irregular jagged notches on the superior trailing edge of the left lobe, indicating non-uniform tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, high-contrast dark circular spot located in the center-right portion of the right lobe's white pigmentation field.
